messages:
sara: Postmortem follow-up on yesterday's auth + model-registry outage. I pulled notes from the call and the runbook. TL;DR: owners, timelines, and validation plan below.

ajay: thanks Sara. can you paste the action list here? tagging @kevin for cloud/auth items

sara: Short list (owners + due dates):
1) Add auth provider fallback + token caching + secondary OAuth provider (owner: kevin) — due 2026-04-10
2) Model-registry read-replica + manifest caching at edge (owner: leah) — due 2026-04-05
3) Circuit breaker + dynamic routing to dedicated pools when region throttles (owner: ajay) — due 2026-04-12
4) Runbook updates + automated incident ticket creation on vendor degradation (owner: norman) — due 2026-03-30
5) Postmortem recurrence detection: scheduled eval to detect patterns across auth/model-registry (owner: sara) — due 2026-04-01

kevin: Acknowledged. For (1) I'll prototype secondary OAuth (Okta -> AzureAD) in staging. quick q: prefer lib-level token cache or gateway cache?

ajay: gateway cache, please — faster to roll out and covers services without SDK changes. gateway already has KV integration.

leah: For model registry replicas: plan is eventual consistency + short TTL edge caches to cover write windows. If anyone needs strong R-A-W we'll add a write-affinity route.

norman: Runbook action: I'll create a \"vendor degraded\" checklist and add automated rollback to last known-good model bundle. Will open PR today.

oncall-bot: Reminder: create tracking issue in repo 'infra-incidents' — use template: vendor-deps/postmortem-actions

sara: I'm creating the issue now and assigning owners. Also proposing a weekly digest that flags recurring incidents over 90d. @ajay can you add an eval to flag auth/model-registry spike patterns?

ajay: yes — will add an eval job + dashboard panels. ETA 3 business days.

kevin: Staging test plan (will post results): 1) simulate auth provider 5m outage; 2) confirm fallback token flow; 3) measure auth latency impact.

leah: I'll draft the manifest-caching migration plan and list all affected services.

sara: Check-in scheduled: 2026-03-28 10:00 PT to review PRs + staging results. If you can't meet ETA, update the tracking issue immediately.

norman: pinged docs for runbook review and availability for walkthrough.

ajay: Adding cutover playbook and rollback steps to the ticket (will include runbook snippets and smoke tests).

kevin: Started staging run — posting quick log: ```
[auth-fallback-test.log]
[00:00] simulate outage -> gateway fallback triggered
[00:03] token refresh errors observed -> secondary provider OK, fallback latency +120ms
[00:05] services recovered using cached tokens
``` :thumbsup:

leah: Noted, will coordinate change windows for manifest rollout.

sara: Thanks all — good cross-team follow-through. I'll update the incident tracker with these items and send calendar invite for the check-in. If anything changes, update the infra-incidents ticket rather than this thread.
extra_context: topic: postmortem follow-ups & action tracking for vendor/dependency outage mitigations (cloud provider issues, model registry, auth providers)
